evidence.title: Pump.fun — Launch and trade memecoins on Solana

name: pump.fun
summary: Solana memecoin launchpad: create a coin, trade instantly on a bonding curve, and track launches.
description: A platform for launching and trading memecoins on Solana. Anyone can create a coin with no platform fee; coins trade on a bonding curve and graduate to the PumpSwap exchange, where creator, protocol and LP fees apply per trade. Explore, leaderboard and live pages track new launches, market caps and trending coins.
contains: create a coin with no platform fee; only Solana network fees
fees: bonding curve, graduation to PumpSwap, creator, protocol and LP
explore feed sorted by movers, new, custom pairs, charities, oldest, last trade
leaderboard and live pages; holder rewards feature
coins pair with SOL, USDC or custom pair assets
charity coins route creator fees to verified nonprofits
